finite_fixture_policy.carrier_families: Finalize only the six CV F-001 through F-006 finite concrete families and sixteen declared negatives from public deterministic recipes. F-004 covers ASCII, multibyte/astral scalars, combining marks, NFC/NFD distinction, U+2028 and escape/control boundaries; N-003 covers explicit invalid UTF8/lone-surrogate error without changing native parser policy. No unannounced exhaustive-domain fixture is mandatory.
finite_fixture_policy.carrier_whole_domain_wording: The admitted viewer domain is Unicode scalar strings; finite listed repertoire/boundary fixtures are tested. This does not establish arbitrary-string or whole-Unicode-domain correctness, arbitrary channel delivery, malformed UTF8/lone-surrogate support, LLM consumption or renderer display correctness.
finite_fixture_policy.ground_candidate_limit: At most4 independently written generic candidates, at most2 fixed assignments each; finite list lengths0 or3 and Nat fold bounds0 or3. Freeze all candidates before baseline exploration; no task-shaped tuning or unbounded search.
finite_fixture_policy.ground_minimal: Use independently authored GR minimal Int identity true and x+1 false source/contract/assignment cases, with no universal-refinement evidence supplying observation. Definitive polarity requires exact kernel theorem, not expected fixture answer.
finite_fixture_policy.no_oracle_authority: Declared fixture expectations are specification labels, never authoritative host truth. No task algorithm/source/proof/formula/answer/private benchmark is an input. Proposers are untrusted.
finite_fixture_policy.recipe_selection: Production each probe uses exactly one frozen recipe/precompilation eligibility rule. Separate engineering baseline/recipe comparisons are separately identified runs; if selection mutates relevant bytes, new freeze and rerun.

finite_stop_rule: Evaluate precisely the final frozen obligations/controls; admit extra closure-critical check only with affected claim ID, possible PASS-to-BLOCK transition and novel mechanical evidence type. Apply three-state rule and stop. Failed required claim freezes complete failure evidence; any repair starts a new closure ID/root from the beginning. No subjective assurance loops.
